answer: Iterated Challenge Relic. Each identity must solve a fresh puzzle derived from a secret relic seeded at registration; the answer is a prism of that relic and a server pulse, verifiable once and then invalidated. Replaying any prior answer fails, since the pulse rotates per request. An attacker cloning identities must obtain a new relic and solve each puzzle independently, paying full compute per clone rather than amortizing one solution.
